_comment: Sample C2 config for connecting the strategy stack to the SIMULATOR. Each FC entry is a marker_mission.app instance (sim drone OR real drone — the C2 doesn't distinguish; it only sees the marker_mission HTTP API: /api/state, /api/start, /api/rc, /api/mission). Run: .venv-c2/bin/python -m marker_mission_c2 --config marker_mission_c2/config.sim.example.json (then strategy: .venv-c2/bin/python -m marker_mission_c2.strategy --config marker_mission_c2/config.sim.example.json --host 127.0.0.1). For the real venue, switch the fcs[].host entries to flightctrlN.tail131b64.ts.net (or the LAN hostname).

fcs.name: sim-1
fcs._note: single-host sim with multiple FC processes on different ports

_fcs_alt_remote_sim: ALTERNATIVE: a single shared sim host with many FCs all on :8080 (different hostnames). Example: [{"name":"sim-1","host":"sim1.tail131b64.ts.net","port":8080}, ...]
